name: 04b. Gemma 4 - Video to Description
description: 04b. Gemma 4 - Video to Description is a image to video workflow designed to animate a still image into a generated video clip using Gemma 4. Its 9-node graph exposes 2 prompt/text field(s), 0 media input target(s), and 0 save/preview stage(s), while preserving the original editor-format graph for reference. The ComfyUI editor graph was converted to API format and is ready for live validation against the connected node and model registry.
instructions:
1. Open the workflow and select Validate. SineForge will compare every node class and input against the currently connected ComfyUI instance without queueing it.
2. Review the model-file entries in Requirements and place each checkpoint, text encoder, VAE, LoRA, or auxiliary model in the folder documented by the source workflow. Refresh ComfyUI after adding files.
3. No required media file was detected in the converted graph; begin with the prompt and generation controls.
4. Set frame count, FPS, dimensions, conditioning strength, and seed. Start with one short clip to verify motion, identity, and memory use before scaling up.
5. Save a copy before making structural changes. Use Editable inputs for normal parameters and Raw API JSON only when you need to inspect or change graph wiring.
6. Validate again after every change. Queue one workflow only after validation passes; then inspect the returned output, logs, duration, dimensions, and media integrity.

The video features a stylized, white rabbit character dressed in a pink ballet outfit, including a leotard and a ruffled tutu, wearing pink ballet shoes with ribbons. The character is depicted in various dance poses against a soft, gradient background that transitions from grey to light pink. In the first frame, the rabbit stands with its arms slightly raised and bent at the elbows, looking forward with a cheerful expression. In the second frame, the rabbit strikes a pose with one arm raised near its face and the other slightly extended, maintaining a focused expression. In the third frame, the rabbit is shown mid-movement, leaning forward with its arms extended out to the sides, appearing graceful. Finally, in the fourth frame, the rabbit is captured in a balanced pose, holding its hands together in front of its body while looking forward with a sweet smile. The lighting is soft and diffused, highlighting the texture of the rabbit's fur and the pink costume. Describe the video exactly. Write only a clear description of what happens in the clip. Include the main subject, actions, movement, expressions, clothing, setting, camera angle, lighting, background, and visible details. Do not summarize too much. Do not explain. Core Capabilities

Gemma 4 models handle a broad range of tasks across text, vision, and audio.

  • Thinking – Built-in reasoning mode that lets the model think step-by-step before answering.
  • Long Context – Context windows of up to 128K tokens for E2B/E4B
  • Image Understanding – Object detection, document/PDF parsing, screen and UI understanding, chart comprehension, OCR including multilingual text, handwriting recognition, and pointing. Images can be processed at variable aspect ratios and resolutions.
  • Video Understanding – Analyze video by processing sequences of frames.
  • Interleaved Multimodal Input – Freely mix text and images in any order within a single prompt.
  • Function Calling – Native support for structured tool use, enabling agentic workflows.
  • Coding – Code generation, completion, and correction.
  • Multilingual – Out-of-the-box support for 35+ languages, pre-trained on 140+ languages.
  • Audio (E2B and E4B only) – Automatic speech recognition and speech-to-translated-text translation across multiple languages.
